checks: Keyboard E boards/leaves once; the repeated event does not toggle twice.
CDP real two-finger direction plus boost stores both keys; ending boost preserves direction, final release clears all.
Escape pause during two-finger hold clears direction and boost; released touches do not resume motion.
Ending a touch after a forced HUD replacement clears its key.
Keyboard movement also clears on pause and does not stick after release.
scope: Independent review of frontier-ui.js/css and main integration. Native post-Council fixture is explicitly prepared with state callbacks; not an end-to-end campaign replay.

notes: Visible prompt and keyboard/touch callback use the same getExploreInteraction target; mounted state prioritizes safe dismount. Boarding distance uses world vehicle availability and does not replace a closer or equally close POI.
Seven new SVG portraits use measured rect viewBoxes and the same normalized native metadata; the eighth Jenkins portrait uses legacy crew art.
Normandy directory adds the four new local speakers and calls getConversation for their actual presence gates. Noveria stays available through its in-world POIs.
